label: Peplink MAX Transit Duo (LTE-A, CAT-12)
description: Transportation router with two LTE-A CAT-12 modems: 1x GE WAN (convertible), 1x GE LAN, 400 Mbps throughput, Wi-Fi.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: Ethernet WAN port **1 / 0 (GE)**, Number of Ethernet LAN port **1 / 2 (GE)**, Router Throughput 400 Mbps, Wi-Fi AP Yes. The footnote says WAN port(s) can be reconfigured, i.e. 1 WAN + 1 LAN or 0 WAN + 2 LAN. **Two modems, two copper ports and a 400 Mbps ceiling** - this box is for a vehicle with two carriers, not for a branch with a rack.
